atoms.a: Modern pop culture, including music and cinema, connects young people from all around the world.
Learning a new language helps students understand different perspectives and cultural values.
Art galleries and museums play an important role in preserving a nation's history.
During traditional festivals, people often wear colourful costumes and perform folk dances in the streets.
Indigenous traditions, passed down through generations by means of oral history, are vital for keeping ancient cultures alive.
In many places, festive traditions like giving gifts and sharing meals bring families closer together.

instruction.text: Welches Wort kommt nicht vor? Wähle es aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5Us_chirp'>In many cultures, it's completely normal to take off your shoes before entering someone's home.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1_chirp'>If you ever go to London, you should definitely check out the street art in Shoreditch.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>Food plays a central role in family celebrations, especially during traditional holidays.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8_chirp'>It was quite a culture shock for me when I realised how late people go to bed here.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3Au_chirp'>Some museums in the city offer free entry for students on the first Sunday of every month.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f11Us_chirp'>I'm really looking forward to the local music festival next weekend because small bands from all over the world will be playing.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6Us_chirp'>My host family taught me how to cook a traditional Sunday roast, which was an amazing experience.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>You don't need to dress up for the theatre performance tonight; normal clothes are totally fine.</voice>
